title: GTA 6 aur India ka connection
hooks: GTA 6 launch ho gaya, par iske peeche asli hero India mein baithe hain.
Kya aapko pata hai GTA 6 banane mein India ka kitna bada haath hai?
GTA 6 ke peeche ki asli kahani, Bengaluru se shuru hoti hai.
hook_why: Starts with the trending topic (GTA 6) and immediately pivots to the 'Indian hero' angle, which is a strong curiosity trigger.
metaphor: The 'bridge' between the global scale of GTA VI and the unseen, massive workforce of Indian developers in Bengaluru.
mechanism: Rockstar Games Bengaluru studio employs over 1,600 developers.
Dhruva Interactive (acquired by Rockstar) contributed to the development.
Indian developers worked on environments, assets, and world-building.
Global impact of Indian talent on the gaming industry.

claims.claim: Rockstar Games Bengaluru studio employs over 1,600 developers who contributed to GTA VI.
Dhruva Interactive was acquired by Rockstar Games in 2019.
PM Modi shared a GTA VI-themed post highlighting India's progress.

steps_learned: Rockstar Games has a studio in Bengaluru.
Over 1,600 developers in Bengaluru contributed to building the game.
Dhruva Interactive was acquired by Rockstar in 2019 and contributed to the game.
PM Modi referenced the GTA 6 launch to comment on India's development.
missing_steps: The script claims Indian developers built 'Vice Beach' or specific assets, but the provided sources only mention general contribution/development work, not specific environmental assets or 'Vice Beach'.
It doesn't explain *how* a studio in Bengaluru collaborates with a global team (e.g., remote assets, specific departments), which would help a viewer understand the 'connection' better.
It fails to clarify that the PM's post was a political comparison (India's progress since GTA V) rather than a direct comment on the game's development quality.
